key_findings: 51-row disclosure map F01-F51; exact schema; disclosure_level restricted to explicit/implicit/future/absent.

Strongest candidate groups: UHV/GDC module (F10-F17, most detailed but enablement-thin), Hall device/fab (F01-F09, largely attributed to prior group work refs 10/11), deployment/validation (F25-F32, best-evidenced with figures).
Grounded graphite shield (F16) is the single most enablement-thin element: no drawings, dimensions, grounding route, or with/without comparison (F40-F42).

No UHV acceptance criterion/outgassing/RGA/leak data (F43); no absolute calibration or numeric sensitivity S_v (F38, F47); no temperature data in-paper (F39); no noise/SNR figures (F45); no GDC exposure log (F46); no inventorship statement (F44); no raw data tables (F48).

Rendered manuscript body contains NO sensor novelty/'first' claim; all three novelty assertions are cover-letter-only (submission.pdf p.9): F49 first GaN Hall sensor in a stellarator; F50 first deployment/validation of platform, no overlap with refs 10/11; F51 unsupported comparative sensitivity claim vs ITER/DEMO metal Hall probes.
Future work F33-F37 locked to future/no/no; no excluded concept recorded as implemented.
